secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (bypasses RLS) for server-side DB access. Found in Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role key. Required for the homepage and all data to load.

secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Lovable platform API key used for the Lovable AI gateway and Google Drive connector. Needed for AI description/clip generation, Drive sync, and Maria chat (fallback).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Drive API key for the Lovable connector gateway. Needed for the admin Drive folder sync feature.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (optional). When set, Maria chat uses OpenRouter (gpt-4o-mini) instead of the Lovable AI gateway.
